nvr.title: NVR
nvr.setup.title: Connect Sentinel NVR
nvr.setup.desc: Enter your Scrypted address and the Sentinel NVR access token (plugin settings → Security). Cameras, events, recordings and live video then show up natively here.
nvr.setup.tokenPlaceholder: Token from the Sentinel NVR plugin settings
nvr.setup.testUnauthorized: Rejected (401) — check the token and that token access is enabled in the plugin
nvr.setup.testUnreachable: Not reachable — check the URL, https and that the certificate is trusted in this browser
nvr.setup.hint: Scrypted usually runs on port 10443 (https). Open the address once in a new tab and accept the certificate if it is self-signed — otherwise the browser blocks the requests silently. The token stays in your own Home Assistant user settings.
nvr.error.title: Sentinel NVR not reachable
nvr.error.unauthorized: The NVR rejected the access token (401). Check the token and that token access is enabled in the plugin.
nvr.error.unreachable: No answer from the NVR. Check the URL, https and whether this browser trusts the certificate.
nvr.error.stale: Connection lost — showing the last known data
